topRisks.title: No authentication is registered anywhere in the app; a destructive endpoint is fully anonymous
No function-level access control distinguishes sensitive actions from public ones
HTTPS redirection is only enabled in Development, not Production
No CI pipeline builds or tests the code on push/PR
Environment-specific backing-service config is hardcoded in versioned appsettings files instead of environment variables

notes: Scoring uses all 41 raw findings' checkResults (pass/fail/N/A) per subject, unaffected by dedup. The deduplicated findings list (38 entries) and severity counts (Error 7, Warning 24, Information 7) exclude the 3 suppressed duplicates. topRisks prioritizes the two Security/Identity & Access Errors and the HTTPS-enforcement Error ahead of the two remaining Errors (SL-01, TF-03) by real-world risk (unauthenticated destructive endpoint > missing CI > appsettings secrets, given TF-03's committed value is a placeholder, not a live credential) rather than a strictly mechanical confidence/effort tiebreak, which would otherwise have left three effort-tied, confidence-tied Errors (SL-01, API-03#1, SEC-WA-06) ambiguously ordered against the two Medium-effort Security Errors. API-03#1/#2 (API Design) did not make the top 5 despite being High/Medium confidence Errors, as they represent spec/documentation drift rather than an exploitable or availability-impacting defect.
